Seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] (Fig [अंजीर]. 2.2) encompasses both the methods and substances used to enhance seed health [बियाण्याचे आरोग्य] before planting. It involves applying physical [शारीरिक तपासणी], chemical, or biological agents to seeds to protect them from pathogens, insects, and other pests that could harm seeds, seedlings, or mature plants. Before discussing these methods, it is necessary to understand some common seed [बियाणे] and seedling [रोप] diseases. After the rainy season [हंगाम/ऋतू] ends, apply *Jeevamrit* twice a month in the soil [माती] near the plants. After this, spray *Jeevamrit* on papaya [पपई] and intercrops as per the following schedule:

- One month after germination [अंकुरण]: Mix 5 litres of *Jeevamrit* in 100 litres of water [पाणी].
- Two months after germination [अंकुरण]: Mix 7 litres of *Jeevamrit* in 100 litres of water [पाणी].
- Three months after germination [अंकुरण]: Mix 10 litres of *Jeevamrit* in 100 litres of water [पाणी].
- Before fruit setting [फळधारणा]: Mix 10 litres of *Jeevamrit* in 100 litres of water [पाणी].
- After fruit setting [फळधारणा]: Mix 3 litres of sour buttermilk in 100 litres of water [पाणी].
- Fifteen days after fruit setting [फळधारणा]: Mix 1 litre of coconut [नारळ] water [पाणी] in 100 litres of water [पाणी].
- Final spray (15 days later): Mix 1 litre of coconut [नारळ] water [पाणी] in 100 litres of water [पाणी].

(ix) Crop Protection [पीक संरक्षण]

- After monsoon [पावसाळा] or irrigation [सिंचन], waterlogging [पाणी साठणे / पाणी साचणे] may cause pest [कीड] and disease [रोग] problems.
- To prevent this, spray *Neemastra*, *Brahmastra*, *Agniastra*, sour buttermilk, and *Soonthastra*.

- \* Soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] is reduced.
- \* Timely planting is possible.
- \* Labor and time are saved.

## **Papaya [पपई]**

**Soil [माती]:** Well-drained, fertile, medium black, red loamy soil [माती] is suitable. Papaya [पपई] trees grow well in lateritic rocky soil [माती]. The pH of the soil [माती] should be 6.5 to 8.0. Papaya [पपई] trees do not grow well in calcareous and rocky soil [माती]. Since the roots of papaya [पपई] trees go deep to 40 cm, the upper layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] of the soil [माती] should be loose and the subsequent 45 cm layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] should be firm murram, which is conducive to the papaya [पपई] crop [पीक].

**Climate [हवामान]:** The papaya [पपई] tree grows in the tropical zone. Extreme cold and strong winds are harmful to this crop [पीक]. Papaya [पपई] requires an average temperature [तापमान] of 15 to 30 degrees Celsius and an annual rainfall of 1500 mm. For the growth [वाढ] of papaya [पपई], the maximum temperature [तापमान] can tolerate up to 42 degrees Celsius and the minimum temperature [तापमान] up to 12 degrees Celsius.

**Varieties:** Dioecious varieties (with male and female flowers on separate trees): Phule Vijaya, Co-8, Washington, Co-5, Co-6, Pusa Dwarf, Pusa Nanha, Pusa Giant. Hermaphrodite varieties: Kug Honey Dew, Co-7, Pusa Delicious, Sunrise Solo, Arka Prabhat, Arka Surya. Co-2, Pusa Majesty varieties are recommended for papain production [उत्पादन].

**Seedling Production [रोपे निर्मीती]:** Prepare seedlings using fresh seeds. In dioecious varieties, 100 to 125 grams of seeds are enough for one hectare, while in hermaphrodite varieties, 30 to 40 grams of seeds per hectare are sufficient. Seedlings grown in polythene bags grow well. For this, use 18 x 33 cm round-bottom plastic bags of 150 gauge to grow the seedlings. Sow [मादी डुक्कर] 1 to 3 seeds in each bag, cover them with well-decomposed compost [कंपोस्ट], and water [पाणी] them. Seedlings are ready for planting in about 6 to 7 weeks.

No-till cultivation means planting the crop [पीक] by digging the soil [माती] just enough for sowing [पेरणी] without any special cultivation. Using such methods for crop [पीक] cultivation has the following advantages [फायदे].

- 1. The available moisture in the soil [माती] lasts longer.
- 2. The cost of cultivation [लागवडीचा खर्च] is reduced. This increases net profit [नफा].
- 3. The infestation of weeds [तण] is reduced.
- 4. Less labour is required. This saves on input costs.

- 5. Since moisture is retained in the soil [माती], crops like pulses can be taken on such residual moisture [अवशिष्ट ओलावा / अवशिष्ट आर्द्रता].
- 6. If crops are to be taken under irrigation [सिंचन], 50 per cent of water [पाणी] is saved.

- 8. Sowing [पेरणी] can be done on time as the cultivation time is saved.

3.9.1 Drip Irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]

The scientific principles of drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] are as follows:

- (i) Water Use Efficiency [जल वापर कार्यक्षमता]: Drip irrigation systems [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली] (Fig [अंजीर]. 3.10) can achieve water [पाणी]-use efficiencies exceeding 90%, compared to 4050% in traditional flood irrigation [मोकाट सिंचन / पूर सिंचन / पटपाणी] methods.<sup>15</sup>
- (ii) Soil Health [मृदा आरोग्य]: By delivering water [पाणी] directly to the root zone [मुळांचा भाग], drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] minimizes soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] and preserves soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना], promoting healthier root development [मुळांची वाढ].
- (iii) Nutrient Management [अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन]: The integration of fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे] allows for precise application [वापर/फवारणी] of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे], enhancing nutrient uptake [अन्नद्रव्य सेवन] and reducing leaching [झिरपण प्रक्रिया] losses.

results.answer:
भात शेतात युरियाचा कार्यक्षम वापर करण्यासाठी नत्राची एकदा सगळी मात्रा देण्याऐवजी तीन टप्प्यांत विभागून द्या, आणि युरियाची खड्ड्यात/गवताच्या फवारणीत खोल अडवून वापर करा, त्यामुळे नत्राचा वाया जाणे कमी होते.

**खत मात्रा व विभागणी (प्रति हेक्टर):**
- १०० कि.ग्रा. नत्र + ५० कि.ग्रा. स्फुरद + ५० कि.ग्रा. पालाश
- पहिली टप्पा: ४० कि.ग्रा. नत्र (८७ कि.ग्रा. युरिया) + ५० कि.ग्रा. स्फुरद + ५० कि.ग्रा. पालाश चिखलणीच्या वेळी
- दुसरी टप्पा: ४० कि.ग्रा. नत्र (पुनर्लागवडीनंतर ३० ते ४० दिवसांनी)
- तिसरी टप्पा: २० कि.ग्रा. नत्र (७० ते ८० दिवसांनी, पिक फुलोऱ्यात असताना)

**कमी नत्र वाया जाण्यासाठी:**
- दुसऱ्या नांगरणीच्या वेळी ५० कि.ग्रा. नत्र (११० कि.ग्रा. युरिया) नांगर सरीमध्ये १५ से.मी. खोल अडवा; यामुळे ५० कि.ग्रा. नत्र वाचतो
- युरिया डी.ए.पी. खडी (खडा) पद्धत वापरू शकता: चार रोपांच्या चौकटीच्या मध्यभागी २.७ ग्रॅम वजनाची एक खडी ५ ते ७ से.मी. खोल द्या; त्यामुळे पाण्यामुळे नत्र/स्फुरद वाया जाणं कमी होते

**इतर सूचना:**
- नत्र खत सगळं एकदा एकदम देऊ नका; दोन किंवा अधिक टप्प्यांत विभागा आणि पाणी व्यवस्थापन चांगलं ठेवा
- युरिया डी.ए.पी. खडी पद्धतीने (१.७० कि.ग्रा. खडी) एक गण्ठा क्षेत्रासाठी साधारण ५७ कि.ग्रा. नत्र + ३३ कि.ग्रा. स्फुरद प्रति हेक्टर उपलब्ध होतात

Remember

Technique

- 1. Animal is casted and legs are secured tightly.
- 2. The foot is then rested on solid board.
- 3. Hoof is then trimmed / cut to its original shape and size by using hoof knife.
- 4. Rasper is then used to level the bottom of hoof.
- 5. Lastly turpentine oil is applied for conditioning and disinfection.
- 6. Over cutting should be avoided as it may lead to injury and lameness [लंगडणे].

8. Chhena Poda

Chhena Poda is a traditional Indian dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] product. Its origin is in Nayagarh, Odisha. This sweet dish is offered as Prasad to the deity at the famous Jagannath Puri Temple. In the Odia language, 'Podo' means 'to bake'. This is the only dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] product prepared by baking on coal. Chhena is made from milk [दूध], and various ingredients are added before it is traditionally baked (cooked) on coal.

- Traditionally, to prepare Chhena Poda, chhena, sugar, semolina (suji [रवा]), and maida [मैदा] (all-purpose flour) are taken in a ratio [प्रमाण] of 20:06:01 and mixed uniformly.
- This mixture is then wrapped in Sal tree [साल] leaves and baked on a flat pan over a coal oven. After cooling in the morning, this dish is ready for consumption/sale.
- For commercial production [उत्पादन], chhena made from cow [गाय]'s milk [दूध] with a fat content [चरबी प्रमाण] of 4.0-4.5% and SNF (Solids-Not-Fat) of 8.5% should be used.
- In this chhena, mix 30-35% sugar and 5% semolina/rava uniformly.
- Desired amount of cardamom [वेलची] powder can also be added to this mixture.
- If the mixture is too thick, a small amount of separated whey [व्हे] from chhena can be added to make it uniform.
- Keep this mixture for 5-40 minutes, then fill it into butter paper or ghee [तूप]-greased aluminium plates (size 10.5 X 8.5 X 4.5 cm) and bake in an oven at 160C for 10 minutes or 200C for 65 minutes.

results.question: हिरवळीच्या खताचा वापर करून जमिनीचा पोत कसा सुधारावा?
results.answer:
हिरवळीच्या खताचा वापर केल्याने जमिनीला सेंद्रिय पदार्थ मिळतो आणि जमिनीच्या पोत सुधारण्यासाठी हा एक सोपा आणि परिणामकारक उपाय आहे.

**हिरवळीचे खत पिके:** बोरो (सन हेम्प), ढैंचा, चवळी अशी पिके शेतात म्हणून हिरवळीचे खतपिक म्हणून घेतली जातात. तसेच गिरिपुष्प, सुबाभळ, शेवारी ही पिके शेताच्या कडेला/पडीक जमिनीवर उगवून त्यांची कलमे आणि पाने शेतात आणता येतात.

**मातीत मिसळण्याचा काळ:** हिरवळीचे खतपिके बहुतेक सूर्यफुलाच्या अवस्थेत किंवा फुलोऱ्याच्या वेळी (ढैंचा, टॅग) मातीत मिसळली जातात. भाताच्या शेतात चिखलणीच्या वेळी गिरिपुष्पाची पाने किंवा हिरवळीची खतपिके (ढैंचा, गिरिपुष्प) मातीत खोलवर मिसळतात.

**प्रमाण (साधारण):**
- भात शेतात गिरिपुष्पाचे हिरवळीचे खत अंदाजे ३ ते ५ टन प्रति हेक्टर चिखलणीत मिसळतात.
- ढैंचा बियाणे ४० कि.ग्रा आणि टॅग ३० कि.ग्रा प्रति हेक्टर पेरायची आणि फुलोऱ्याच्या वेळी मिसळावी.
- गिरिपुष्पाची ४ ते ६ झाडांची पाने अंदाजे १ गुंठ्यासाठी (सुमारे १०० चौ.मी.) पुरेशी ठरतात.

**जमिनीचा पोत कसा सुधारतो:** हिरवळीच्या खतातून मिळालेले सेंद्रिय पदार्थ जमिनीतील जीवाणूंची कार्यक्षमता वाढवतात आणि त्यामुळे जमिनीचा शारीरिक व रासायनिक गुणधर्म (पोत) मूलभूत बदलून सुधारतो. हिरवळीचे खत जलद कुजल्याने नत्र, स्फुरद आणि पालाश या पोषकांची लगेच उपलब्धता वाढते.

**स्रोत: डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला**

तुमची जमीन भात शेतीत आहे की पेरू शेतीत, आणि तुम्हाला कोणत्या पिकासाठी हिरवळीचे खत घ्यायचे आहे?

b) Green Manures

Green manures provide organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] to the soil [माती] which increases the efficiency of the bacteria [जीवाणू] in the soil [माती] thereby leading to a radical improvement in the physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] and chemical properties of the soil [माती]. The types of green manures and the amount of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] and organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] supplied to the soil [माती] are given in the following table.

Research conducted by the university has shown that applying 10 tons of *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* leaves per hectare yields as much rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ] as the recommended dose [मात्रा] of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] (100 kg N + 50 kg P + 50 kg K).

*Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* seedlings or cuttings [कापणी टप्पे] should be planted on the bunds of the field [शेत] or fallow land [पडीक जमीन] at the beginning of the monsoon [पावसाळा] season [हंगाम/ऋतू]. As *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* grows rapidly at the beginning of the monsoon [पावसाळा], plenty of *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* leaves will be available at the time of rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ] transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] of rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ]. Generally, the leaves of 4 to 6 trees are enough for one Guntha (approximately 100 square meters). The leaves should be buried in the soil [माती] during puddling [चिखलणी] before rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ] transplanting [पुनर्लागवड] of rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ]. *Gliricidia [गिरिपुष्प] sepium* leaves contain 2.75 per cent nitrogen [नत्र], 0.5 per cent phosphorus [स्फुरद], and 1.15 per cent potassium [पालाश]. ```
**Integrated Nutrient Management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] (INM):**

The method of using organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते], green manures, bacterial fertilizers, and organic [सेंद्रिय] liquids in appropriate proportions as complementary fertilizers along with chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] is called Integrated Nutrient Management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन].

In this method, a balance is maintained between chemical, organic [सेंद्रिय], and biological fertilizers [जैविक खत]. Also, by including leguminous crops [शेंगायुक्त पीक] in crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता] is maintained. In this method, along with bumper crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन], the quality of food grains [धान्ये] and soil [माती] is also improved. By saving expensive chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], soil productivity [मृदा उत्पादकता] is continuously improved year after year. In this method, generally half of the total requirement of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] is supplied through chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], and the remaining half is supplied through organic fertilizers [सेंद्रिय खते]. It is recommended to take green manure crops [हिरवळीची खतपिके] and bury them in the soil [माती] once every three years. All crop [पीक] residues like sugarcane [ऊस] trash, sorghum [ज्वारी] stalks, wheat [गहू] and paddy stubble [खुंट], sunflower [सूर्यफूल / सुर्यफुल] stalks, and all residues of pulse [डाळ] crops, etc., are buried in the soil [माती] to increase the amount of organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ]. Along with this, it is necessary to use bacterial fertilizers and vermicompost [गांडूळखत].

**The following points should be considered while selecting chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:**

1. For long-term crops, compound fertilizers should be used (Nitrophosphate 15:15:15) (Ammo. Phosphate 28:28:0).
2. To facilitate the availability of phosphorus [स्फुरद], completely soluble fertilizers should be selected. E.g., Single Super Phosphate, Diammonium Phosphate.
3. Sulfur-containing fertilizers should be included for pulses and oilseeds. E.g., Ammonium Sulfate, Single Super Phosphate, Ammo. Phosphate, Sulfate.
4. To increase the efficiency of phosphorus [स्फुरद], phosphorus [स्फुरद]-solubilizing bacteria [जीवाणू] (PSB) fertilizers should be used.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] should be suspected when any litters are born dead or weak, as also when abnormalities of the eyes [डोळे] are present in newborn piglets. If the litters of young pigs are very susceptible to enteritis and pneumonia, or if paralysis of the hindquarters is often seen in pigs in the piggery, then it is necessary to check if there is enough green feed [खाद्य/चारा]/fodder [चारा] or vitamin A in the diet.

Enteritis, pneumonia and paralysis are not necessarily caused by vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव]. A common disease [रोग] causing a similar birth of dead piglets is leptospirosis [लेप्टोस्पायरोसिस]. In this disease [रोग], the infected sow [मादी डुक्कर] does not show any obvious symptom [लक्षण] until she aborts, which may occur two to four weeks before farrowing [डुक्कर जन्म देणे] takes place. If the sow [मादी डुक्कर] farrows at full time, the piglets are born dead or weak. For diagnosis [निदान] of hypovitaminosis A, testing of sow [मादी डुक्कर]'s blood [रक्त] serum [सिरम] is essential.

Treatment [उपचार] and control [नियंत्रण]

When there are obvious symptoms [लक्षणे] of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], a dose [मात्रा] of 10 000 IU of the vitamin A supplement should be given as a drench. Pigs suffering from vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव] will usually respond very quickly when the vitamin is supplied in adequate amounts, but animals with advanced symptoms [लक्षणे] such as marked muscular incoordination or blindness seldom recover completely.

Control [नियंत्रण]

To prevent the occurrence of vitamin A deficiency [जीवनसत्त्व अ चा अभाव], good quality fresh green feed [खाद्य/चारा] should be provided daily, or a vitamin A supplement added to the feed [खाद्य/चारा]. About 60 g of green feed [खाद्य/चारा] should be provided to each pig [वराह] daily. Whole milk [दूध] has fairly large amounts of vitamin A, but skim milk [स्किम्ड दूध] is a very poor source as are most milk [दूध] products, meat [मांस] meal [जेवण] and grain [धान्य] (except maize [मका] which is very high in carotene). Cod liver oil and fish [मासे] oils contain large amounts of vitamin A and can be used as supplements, but it is easier and cheaper to use one of the commercial synthetic stabilized vitamin A supplements. These can be obtained in powder or liquid emulsion form for mixing with the feed [खाद्य/चारा]; details about the quantities to be fed are supplied with the various preparations. Many commercial preparations contain vitamin A together with vitamin D.

6.3.6 Goose stepping (Pantothenic acid deficiency)

Definition and etiology [रोगकारण]

Pantothenic acid, also known as vitamin B5, is essential for normal physiological functions in pigs. It plays an important role in the synthesis and metabolism of carbohydrates, proteins and fats. Deficiency of this vitamin can lead to a variety of clinical symptoms [लक्षणे], particularly affecting growing pigs and pregnant sows.

Inadequate dietary intake of pantothenic acid, particularly in growing pigs and pregnant sows, lead to the development of deficiency symptoms [लक्षणे]. Lowquality or improperly formulated feeds may lack sufficient levels of essential vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] and minerals [खनिजे], including pantothenic acid. Any concurrent gastrointestinal disease [रोग]/problems that affect the absorption of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] from the gastrointestinal tract can also contribute to deficiencies.

Clinical signs

Clinical signs include loss of appetite [भूक कमी होणे], leading to significant weight loss [वजन कमी होणे] and poor growth [वाढ] rates. Goose-stepping gait is a distinctive, exaggerated high-stepping style of walking [चालणे], primarily affecting the hind limbs, that is commonly observed in pigs with this deficiency. It results from nerve damage and muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता], resulting in a lack of muscle coordination leading to an unsteady and staggering walk. Non-infectious bloody diarrhoea [अतिसार] in few cases is also reported. In severe deficiency, death may occur as a result of complete anorexia.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] of deficiency cannot always be made based only on response to nutritional therapy, particularly if it is a long-term deficiency. **माती/खत:**
- **भुईमूग:** प्रति हेक्टर **१० कि.ग्रा झिंक सल्फेट** वरंबे/सरी भरून देण्याआधी/सोबत, व **५ कि.ग्रा बोरॅक्स** प्रत्येक तीन वर्षांनी.
- **तांदूळ (पेरसली):** पेरणीच्या वेळी प्रति हेक्टर **१० कि.ग्रा झिंक सल्फेट** (सोबत **१० कि.ग्रा फेरस सल्फेट**).
- **ऊस (कडक माती):** प्रति हेक्टर **२० कि.ग्रा झिंक सल्फेट** व **२५ कि.ग्रा फेरस सल्फेट** शेणखतात मिसळून १५ दिवस ठेवून १:१० प्रमाणात मातीत देणे.
- **गहू (झिंक कमी असलेल्या मातीत):** पेरणीआधी एक आठवड्याने प्रति हेक्टर **२० कि.ग्रा झिंक सल्फेट** शेणखतात १:१० प्रमाणात मिसळून देणे.

results.question: जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कर्ब वाढवण्यासाठी सेंद्रिय मार्ग सुचवा.
results.answer:
जमिनीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन वाढवण्यासाठी सेंद्रिय मार्गांचा भर द्या; शेणखत, कंपोस्ट, गांडूळखत, हिरवळीचे खत, आणि पिकांचे अवशेष यांचा वापर नियमितपणे करा, तसेच आंतरपीक/मिश्रपीक, आच्छादन आणि कमी मशागत अशा उपाययोजना करा.

**सेंद्रिय खतांची वाढ:** शेणखत, कंपोस्ट, शेळी-मेंढी खत, कोंबडी खत, गहू-सुर्यफूल काडणी, आणि इतर पिकांचे अवशेष जमिनीत मिसळावेत; सेंद्रिय पदार्थ विघटनाच्या नंतर त्यात सेंद्रिय कार्बन ५० ते ५८ टक्के पर्यंत असू शकतो.

**हिरवळीचे खत:** ढैंचा, ग्वार, उडीद, मूग, चवळी आणि कलिंगडासारखी पिके वाढून फुलांच्या अवस्थेत जमिनीत पसरावीत; तसेच ग्लायरिसिडिया, सुबाभळ यांचे तरतरे/पाने जमिनीत पुरावेत.

**पीक अवशेष आणि आच्छादन:** पिकाचे अवशेष जाळू नयेत; एक-तृतीयांश भाग जमिनीत पुरावावा आणि ऊस काडणी/गहू काडणीने आच्छादन करावे; अवशेषांचे विघटन वेगळे करण्यासाठी ट्रायकोडर्मा बुरशीचा वापर करता येतो.

**जमिनीची मशागत व धूप रोखणे:** मशागत कमी करावी, पातळ/समतल करणे करावे, आणि पाण्याचे/मातीचे संवर्धन करून जमिनीची धूप टाळावी.

**पीक प्रणाली:** आंतरपीक व मिश्रपीक (महसूल पीक पद्धत) पद्धती वापरल्यास सेंद्रिय कार्बन वाढतो, तसेच शेंगायुक्त/डाळ पिकांचा समावेश करावा.

**इतर उपाय:** शेताच्या सीमेवर वारा थांबवणारे अडथळे, ग्लायरिसिडिया/हिरवळीची पिके लागवावीत, आणि शेती पशुपालनासोबत एकात्मिक करावी.

**स्रोत: वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ, महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, नीती आयोग**

तुम्ही ह्यापैकी कोणती सेंद्रिय उपाययोजना नियमित करत आहात, आणि तुमच्या शेतात पाणी/मशागत कशी होतेय?

9.3 Carbon Credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] Generation in Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

In natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती], the accumulation of stable carbon in the soil [माती] is driven by the constant addition of biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] through mulching [आच्छादन] and the enhanced activity of microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव]. This system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] converts agricultural lands into carbon sinks, which mitigates climate change [हवामान बदल] and improves the water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती]. This enhancement increases resilience to drought [दुष्काळ] and rainfall variability. While precise large-scale quantification is an ongoing area of research, the foundational principles align directly with the objectives of carbon farming [कार्बन शेती]. Natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] employs multiple regenerative practices that either remove carbon from the atmosphere or prevent its release:

9.3.1 Increased Organic Matter Addition [सेंद्रिय पदार्थांची भर]

(i) Regular application [वापर/फवारणी] of farmyard manure [शेणखत] (FYM), compost [कंपोस्ट], crop [पीक] residues, and green manures builds soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन].

9.3.2 Agroforestry [कृषिवनशास्त्र] and Tree Integration

(i) Incorporating trees, hedges, and perennials enhances aboveground and belowground biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon.

9.3.3 Mulching [आच्छादन] and Cover Cropping [आच्छादन पीक लागवड]

(i) Maintains continuous soil [माती] cover, prevents erosion [धूप/झीज], and adds biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ].

(i) Helps preserve existing carbon stocks by minimizing oxidation.

9.3.5 Elimination of Synthetic Inputs

(i) Avoids nitrous oxide emissions from chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते] and reduces energy footprint.

Conclusion [निष्कर्ष]

Carbon credits [कार्बन क्रेडिट्स] in natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] represent a winwin solution: they reward farmers for climatepositive practices, reduce national GHG emissions, and attract new forms of green finance into rural areas. 4.1 Introduction

Soil [माती] is a fundamental resource for food production [उत्पादन] and a crucial asset for farmers. The success of farming [शेती करणे] relies on soil quality [मृदा गुणवत्ता], as it supplies water [पाणी] and vital nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to crops. When soil [माती] is rich and healthy, combined with adequate water [पाणी] and sunlight, it supports productive farming [शेती करणे] and helps achieve desired yields. Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] treats soil [माती] as a living, multifunctional system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], where soil organic matter [मृदा सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], or humus [ह्युमस], serves as a critical reservoir supporting nutrient [पोषक घटक] retention, water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता], and soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना] (FAO, 2015). Incorporating farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] significantly enhances microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] and diversity, thereby increasing soil [माती] resilience and nutrient cycling [अन्नद्रव्य चक्र / पोषण चक्र] through the activation of indigenous microbes (Semenov et al., 2021). Long-term use of organic [सेंद्रिय] amendments (e.g., FYM applied at 15 t/ha) markedly increases soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], dissolved organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], and key nutrient [पोषक घटक] pools under pearl milletwheat rotations (Sheoran et al., 2025). Soil pH [मातीचा सामू / मृदा सामू], a key determinant of nutrient availability [पोषण मूल्य उपलब्धता], can be effectively managed using natural amendments: lime [चुना] in highly acidic soils-and manure [खत] or straw in moderately acidic soils-not only raise pH by 12-17%, but also improve cation exchange capacity [धनायन विनिमय / कॅटायन विनिमय क्षमता], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and crop yield [पीक उत्पादन] (Zhang et al., 2023). A balanced soil [माती] ecosystem, therefore, emerges from the synergy of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] enrichment, microbial vitality, and pH correction, all achieved without synthetic inputs.

Indian Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] experiments have reported measurable improvements in soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] parameters. ICARNAARM field [शेत] studies under Zero Budget Natural Farming [शून्य खर्च नैसर्गिक शेती] in Andhra Pradesh recorded an increase of 821% in soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], 1327% higher microbial biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon, and significantly higher soil [माती] enzymatic activity compared to conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] systems. Similarly, long-term NF trials in soybeanmaize and wheatmustard systems reported 1.31.8 times higher populations of beneficial soil microbes [मृदा सूक्ष्मजीव] and improved soil aggregation [मातीचे एकत्रीकरण] and moisture retention [ओलावा टिकवून धरणे] under Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] practices.17

results.question: What is the treatment for Milk Fever in buffaloes?
results.answer:
म्हैसामध्ये दूध फीवरचा उपचार माहिती मिळाली, पण नेमकी मात्रा व वेळ तपशील दस्तऐवजात स्पष्ट नाही, म्हणून मी फक्त उपलब्ध भाग सांगतो.

लक्षणे:
- व्यानेनंतर अंदाजे ७२ तासांच्या आत रोग उफाळतो.
- प्राथमिक अवस्थेत म्हैस अशांत, हालचाली अनियमित, टाचा आणि डोक्याला कंप येतात, आणि जमिनीवर झोपते व डोकं भुव्याकडे वळवून ठेवते.
- गंभीर अवस्थेत तापमान कमी पडतो, पार्शा उमटतात, व्होकल/मोठ्या शब्दांत बेहोश होऊन मृत्यू होऊ शकतो अशी नोंद आहे.

उपचार (दस्तऐवजात स्पष्ट भाग):
- व्हेनमध्ये कॅल्शियम बोरोग्लुकोनेट द्रावण द्या.
- पसंतीनुसार, दस्तऐवजात नोंद अशी आहे: ३०० ते ४०० मिलि कॅल्शियम बोरोग्लुकोनेट व्हेनमध्ये देणे.
- एकत्र, विटामिन डी३ स्वरूपात इंजेक्शन दिल्याची नोंद आहे.

प्रतिबंध व नियंत्रण (उपलब्ध भाग):
- नियमितपणे, म्हैसाला वरचे चुना पाणी मिश्रण द्यायला सांगितले आहे.
- दस्तऐवजात तंतोतंत मात्रा स्पष्ट नसल्यामुळे, या भागात पशुवैद्यकाचा सल्ला घ्या.

**स्रोत: Dairy Management for livelihood support of farmers (MANAGE, हैदराबाद)**

Mastitis [स्तनदाह] A Common Udder [कास] Problem in Cows and Buffaloes

What is Mastitis [स्तनदाह]?

Mastitis [स्तनदाह] is swelling [सूज] and infection [संसर्ग] of the udder [कास] (milk [दूध]-producing organ) in cows and buffaloes. It is one of the most common and costly diseases in dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] animals.It happens when germs (tiny dirty bugs) go inside the udder [कास]. This causes pain [वेदना], swelling [सूज], and bad milk [दूध].

There are Two Main Types of Mastitis [स्तनदाह]:

1. Visible Mastitis [स्तनदाह] (Clinical Mastitis [स्तनदाह])

This type can be seen with the eyes [डोळे]. Signs:

- The udder [कास] becomes red, hot, or swollen
- The udder [कास] is painful to touch
- Milk [दूध] becomes watery, yellow, or has clots
- Sometimes milk [दूध] looks like it has grains [धान्ये] or pus
- The animal may have fever [ताप] or look sick

2. Hidden Mastitis [स्तनदाह] (Subclinical Mastitis [स्तनदाह])

This type cannot be seen easily.

- Milk production [दूध उत्पादन] slowly goes down
- Milk [दूध] looks normal, but it is poor quality
- This can be found only by special tests (like CMT test)
- This is more dangerous because it shows no early signs.

**Useful Points for Clean Milk Production [स्वच्छ दूध उत्पादन]:** The milking [दूध काढणे] area should be dry [कोरडे] and clean. Before milking [दूध काढणे], the udder [कास] should be thoroughly washed and dried. The hands of the milker should be dry [कोरडे] and should not have any kind of wound [जखम]. Cows and buffaloes frequently flick their tails while milking [दूध काढणे]. At this time, there is a possibility of dirt, dust, and dead hair from their body falling into the milk [दूध]. **Management [व्यवस्थापन] Points for Keeping the Health [आरोग्य] of Cows and Buffaloes Healthy:**

**Vaccination [लसीकरण]:** Vaccinate to control [नियंत्रण] infectious diseases. Vaccinate against diseases like foot-and-mouth disease [रोग], black quarter [काळपुळी रोग], hemorrhagic septicemia, brucellosis [ब्रुसॅलोसिस] (frequent abortion [गर्भपात]), theileriosis [थायलेरीओसिस] (tick fever [ताप]) according to the schedule with the help of a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक].

**Disease Diagnosis [रोग निदान] Testing:** Check for the occurrence of incurable diseases. Medication for diseases like TB, Jones, Brucellosis [ब्रुसॅलोसिस] is expensive. Cows and buffaloes do not recover completely from this. Diseased cows and buffaloes identified through veterinary examination should be removed from the herd [पशूंचे झुंड]. The livestock [पशुधन] and shed [निवारा] should be cleaned regularly. To prevent mastitis [स्तनदाह], the milk [दूध] of cows and buffaloes that are lactating should be checked regularly morning and evening, and the udder [कास]/teats of the livestock [पशुधन] should be observed. If swelling [सूज] is felt on the udder [कास]/teats, immediate treatment [उपचार] should be given by a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक].

**Use of Dewormer:** Deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] medicine should be given twice a year, i.e., before the start of the rainy season [हंगाम/ऋतू] and after the end of the rainy season [हंगाम/ऋतू]. Which dewormer and in what quantity should be given depends on the dewormer, the weight of the animal, and the age. Consult a veterinarian [पशुवैद्यक] for deworming [कृमिनाशक देणे] and medication. Change the dewormer on the advice of a veterinary expert instead of using the same dewormer permanently.

- Mortality rate may be as high as 80 %.
- Germs of this disease [रोग] survive longer in humid and waterlogged conditions.

- High temperature [तापमान], sudden decrease in milk yield [दुधाचे उत्पादन].

- Animal usually dies within 1-2 days of showing symptoms [लक्षणे].
- Buffaloes are generally more susceptible than cattle [गाय वर्ग].
- Animals with clinical signs, particularly buffalo [म्हैस], rarely recover.
- In endemic areas, most deaths seen in older calves and young adults.

*Severe throat and brisket oedema*

- Avoid crowding especially during wet seasons.

Stall-fed Goat Farming [शेळी पालन]: Goats do not require very expensive sheds. If sheds with roofs are built using available materials or low-cost materials, they will last for 5 to 6 years. For this, emphasis can be placed on easily available materials (e.g., bamboo [बांबू], iron [लोह] pipes, etc.). Also, for roofing, the use of grass or unused roofing tiles can be economically affordable.

It is necessary to build the sheds on high ground. While determining the direction of the sheds, if they are kept south-north or east-west, the wetness in the shed [निवारा] is reduced due to the soft sun rays in the morning and evening. Also, due to the unique sunlight available, the germicidal process helps to disinfect the sheds. Each goat [शेळी] should get 10 to 12 sq. ft. of space. There should be open space around the sheds, and trees like *subabhul*, asana, dhaman, shivan, umber, etc. should be planted in this space, if possible. In addition to shade and clean air, the foliage of these trees can be used as food for the goats.

Generally, a herd [पशूंचे झुंड] of 50 goats is profitable for stall-fed goat farming [शेळी पालन]. Generally, one male buck [शेळीचा नर] is sufficient for 25 to 30 females. Such males should be one to one and a half years old. The age of the female should be one year. In stall-fed farming [शेती करणे], clean drinking water [स्वच्छ पाणी देणे] should be provided in the shed [निवारा] through semi-circular cement pipes. By painting these pipes with lime [चुना], the occurrence of germs in the water [पाणी] can be avoided. Arrange the goats/bucks and small kids according to their age. Sick and contagious [संसर्गजन्य] goats should be separated immediately. **अन्नाची योजना (संतुलित आहार):**
- म्हशीला प्रथिने, ऊर्जा, जीवनसत्त्वे आणि खनिजांचा संतुलित आहार द्या, कारण पोषक तत्वांची कमतरता किंवा असंतुलनामुळे दूध कमी होते आणि आरोग्य खराब होते.
- म्हशीस हिरवा चारा, कोरडा चारा, दाणेदार खाद्य (कंपाऊंड फीड, पेंड, धान्ये आणि धान्याचे उपजन्य), आणि खनिज मिश्रण यांचा समावेश असलेली रेशन तयार करा.
- एकच दिवसात अचानक आहार बदलू नका; नवीन घटक ७–१० दिवसांत हळूहळू मिसळा.
- दाणेदार खाद्य वाढवायचे असल्यास प्रति दिवस सरासरी ०.५–०.७ कि.ग्रा. ने हळूहळू वाढवा.

**उन्हाळा/आर्द्रता काळातील पूरक:**
- तापमान-आर्द्रता सूचकांक ७२ पेक्षा जास्त असल्यास (म्हैस उष्णतेच्या ताणास जास्त अती संवेदनशील असतो), पुढील पूरक वापरायचे असल्याचे दिले आहे:
  - नायसीन (व्हिटॅमिन-बी३) प्रति दिवस प्रति म्हैस ६ ग्रॅम
  - यीस्ट प्रति दिवस प्रति म्हैस १० ग्रॅम
  - मोहरी तेल प्रति दिवस प्रति म्हैस १५० ग्रॅम
- पाणी मोकळ्याने, नेहमी थंड (साधारणपणे) आणि स्वच्छ द्या.
- रसाळ चारा आणि खाण्याची वारंवारता वाढवा; रात्री आणि सकाळी जास्तीत जास्त अन्न द्या—सकाळी ६–८ वाजता आणि रात्री ८–१० वाजता.
- आहारातील एकूण ओलावा ५०% पेक्षा जास्त होणार नाही याची काळजी घ्या.
- फॉगर/मोलासेस/आंशिक ओल्या मिश्रित खाद्य वापरणे उपयुक्त असू शकते असे नमूद आहे.

**इतर व्यवस्थापन:**

Ensure the composition of diets reflects production [उत्पादन] level, reproductive stage [पुनरुत्पादक अवस्था / प्रजनन अवस्था], body size, housing [निवास व्यवस्था] and weather [वातावरण] conditions.
- Test nutrient [पोषक घटक] content of feed [खाद्य/चारा] ingredients periodically by consulting an animal nutritionist/dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] expert from a local agricultural/veterinary university/ Krishi Vigyan Kendras (Farm [शेत] science Centres at district [जिल्हा] level).
- Ensure all rations have been balanced and that all feed [खाद्य/चारा] components used in the ration are of good quality and free of spoilage.
- Where a change of feed [खाद्य/चारा] is needed it should be introduced gradually, e.g. over a 7 - 10 day period. Abrupt changes in diet should be avoided.
- When increasing concentrates [दाणेदार खाद्य], do so gradually (0.5 to 0.7 kg / head / day) according to appetite [भूक].

Milk Standardization [दूधाचे प्रमानिकीकरण]

Milk standardization [दूधाचे प्रमानिकीकरण] generally means balancing the proportion of fat and Solid Not Fat (SNF) to comply with legal requirements for milk [दूध] in the market. According to the Food Safety and Standards Act [अन्न सुरक्षा आणि मानके कायदा], four types of milk [दूध] are produced. These are classified based on different fat (snigdhaansh) and non-fat components. The following four types of classified milk [दूध] are generally found in the market:

| Sr. | Milk [दूध] Classification | Fat (%) | SNF (%) |
|-----|----------------------|---------|---------|
| No. | | | |
| 1 | Toned Milk [टोनड मिल्क] | | . |
| | | | |
| 2 | Double Toned Milk [डबल टोनड मिल्क] | . | . |
| 3 | Standardized Milk [स्टँडर्ड मिल्क] | . | . |
| 4 | Buffalo [म्हैस] Milk [दूध] or Full | . | . |
| | Cream Milk [दूध] | | |

A cream separator [क्रीम वेगळे करणारे यंत्र] is used for milk standardization [दूधाचे प्रमानिकीकरण]. With the help of this equipment, the fat and SNF components in milk [दूध] are brought to a specific proportion and the excess fat is removed. When using a cream separator [क्रीम वेगळे करणारे यंत्र], if the milk [दूध] temperature [तापमान] is between 35 to 40 degrees Celsius, the separation process proceeds smoothly.

Homogenization [होमोजिनायझेशन]

Homogenization [होमोजिनायझेशन] is a process of reducing the size of fat particles in milk [दूध]. This process prevents the formation of a cream layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] on the milk [दूध]. Also, such milk [दूध] is beneficial for digestion. The taste [चव] or flavour of homogenized milk [दूध] is uniformly distributed throughout the milk [दूध]. Due to the uniformly distributed fat particles in the milk [दूध], this milk [दूध] is whiter, richer, smoother, and creamier than unprocessed, unhomogenized milk [दूध]. A homogenizer [होमोजिनायझर] is used for this process. If the milk [दूध] is standardized and needs to be transported over a long distance, homogenization [होमोजिनायझेशन] is necessary to prevent the fat from separating during transportation [वाहतूक].

Milk Packaging [दूध पॅकेजिंग]

According to the Food Safety [अन्न सुरक्षा] Act, processed milk [दूध] must be packaged and sold. Various types of packing machines are used for packaging [पॅकेजिंग] milk [दूध]. In the market, milk [दूध] is generally pasteurized milk [पाश्चुरीकृत दूध].

*Nutritional factors associated with low productivity*

Buffaloes are better converter of poor-quality fibrous feeds to milk [दूध] and meat [मांस]. Because of larger rumen [रुमेन], slower rumen [रुमेन] movement, passage rate and higher microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] in the rumen [रुमेन], buffaloes have better digestive ability of feeds. Better degradability of protein [प्रथिने] was also reported in buffaloes (Terramoccia et al., 2000). Despite of these merits, buffalo [म्हैस] have relatively poor reproductive efficiency [प्रजनन कार्यक्षमता]. Buffalo [म्हैस] exhibit many reproductive anarchies including delayed onset of puberty, poor estrus expression, longer postpartum ovarian quiescence [सुप्तावस्था], and most importantly lowered conception rates. However, higher fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] could be achieved through better feeding [खाऊ घालणे] and management [व्यवस्थापन] (Paul and Lal, 2010).

The majority of the farmers in developing countries use low input production [उत्पादन] system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] of animal rearing, resulting low productivity. The greatest scope for improving milk production [दूध उत्पादन] is through a strategy which targets improvement of reproductive performance. To reduce the cost of rearing and be economical to the farmers, the buffalo [म्हैस] must grow rapidly, achieve puberty as soon as possible, conceive readily, produce a healthy calf [वासरू] and continue producing calves and milk [दूध] until productive life. Buffaloes exhibit a distinct seasonal change in displaying oestrus, conception rate [गर्भधारण दर] and calving [व्याने] rate which could be the cause of the prolonged inter-calving [व्याने] period since buffalo [म्हैस] calving [व्याने] during the unfavourable season [हंगाम/ऋतू] may not resume their ovarian activity until the following favourable season [हंगाम/ऋतू], decreasing their reproductive efficiency [प्रजनन कार्यक्षमता].

Nutrition [पोषण] plays a pivotal role in maintaining the body condition, production [उत्पादन] and reproductive efficiency [प्रजनन कार्यक्षमता] of dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] animals. Nutrition [पोषण] consists of different nutrients [पोषक तत्वे], but mainly includes protein [प्रथिने], fat, carbohydrates and micro-elements. Carbohydrates and proteins provide substrates for rumen [रुमेन] fermentation, which results in the production [उत्पादन] of volatile fatty acids (VFA). Animals utilize these VFAs as their main source of energy for maintenance, milk production [दूध उत्पादन] and reproductive performance (Ibtisham et al., 2018).

Balanced ration

A balanced ration is a ration which provides the essential nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to the animal in such proportion and amounts that are required for the proper nourishment for 24 hours as per physiological status [शारीरिक स्थिती] of the animal.

Desirable characteristics of a ration

- The ration should be properly balanced
- The ration must be palatable
- Variety of feed [खाद्य/चारा] in the ration
- The ration should contain enough of mineral matter
- The ration should be fairly laxative

Feedstuffs for cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes feeding [खाऊ घालणे]

Balanced rations for cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes feeding [खाऊ घालणे] are made up of five basic types of feedstuffs. When combined in the right amounts, these feeds can supply all the nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] needed to keep cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes healthy and productive. These five types of feedstuffs are:

a. Bulk forages for energy

These are mostly grass-like plants that have long stems, long narrow leaves and flower spikes and contain a lot of fibre in their structure. They include fresh materials, such as green grass, as well as dry [कोरडे] materials, such as straw and hay. They provide most of the energy an animal needs and some minerals [खनिजे] and will make up most of the ration they are

what fills the animal and stops it feeling hungry. Most bulk forages contain only low levels of protein [प्रथिने].

b. Supplementary forages for energy and protein [प्रथिने]

Supplementary forages provide both energy and protein [प्रथिने] and some minerals [खनिजे]. These are fibrous plants, similar to bulk forages, but they are usually especially grown on the farm [शेत] as feed [खाद्य/चारा] for cattle [गाय वर्ग] and buffaloes and contain higher protein [प्रथिने] and/or energy levels than bulk forages.

Milk standardization [दूधाचे प्रमानिकीकरण] generally means balancing the proportion of fat and Solid Not Fat (SNF) to comply with legal requirements for milk [दूध] in the market. According to the Food Safety and Standards Act [अन्न सुरक्षा आणि मानके कायदा], four types of milk [दूध] are produced. These are classified based on different fat (snigdhaansh) and non-fat components. A cream separator [क्रीम वेगळे करणारे यंत्र] is used for milk standardization [दूधाचे प्रमानिकीकरण]. With the help of this equipment, the fat and SNF components in milk [दूध] are brought to a specific proportion and the excess fat is removed. When using a cream separator [क्रीम वेगळे करणारे यंत्र], if the milk [दूध] temperature [तापमान] is between 35 to 40 degrees Celsius, the separation process proceeds smoothly.

Homogenization [होमोजिनायझेशन]

Homogenization [होमोजिनायझेशन] is a process of reducing the size of fat particles in milk [दूध]. This process prevents the formation of a cream layer [अंडी देणारी कोंबडी] on the milk [दूध]. Also, such milk [दूध] is beneficial for digestion. The taste [चव] or flavour of homogenized milk [दूध] is uniformly distributed throughout the milk [दूध]. Due to the uniformly distributed fat particles in the milk [दूध], this milk [दूध] is whiter, richer, smoother, and creamier than unprocessed, unhomogenized milk [दूध]. A homogenizer [होमोजिनायझर] is used for this process. If the milk [दूध] is standardized and needs to be transported over a long distance, homogenization [होमोजिनायझेशन] is necessary to prevent the fat from separating during transportation [वाहतूक].

Milk Packaging [दूध पॅकेजिंग]

According to the Food Safety [अन्न सुरक्षा] Act, processed milk [दूध] must be packaged and sold. Various types of packing machines are used for packaging [पॅकेजिंग] milk [दूध]. In the market, milk [दूध] is generally pasteurized milk [पाश्चुरीकृत दूध].

Definition and Etiology [रोगकारण]

Downer cow [गाय] syndrome is a group of syndromes noticed as a complication to milk [दूध] fever [ताप] in high yielding dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] animals and is characterized by prolonged recumbency despite treatment [उपचार] with intravenous calcium [कॅल्शियम] preparation. Traumatic injury to limb muscles and nerves prior to parturition or at the time of parturition may also lead to downer.

Predisposing Factors

Delayed treatment [उपचार] of milk [दूध] fever [ताप], traumatic injury to sciatic nerve and pelvic muscle, serum [सिरम] electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] abnormality (Na, K, Mg, Ca) and slippery floor in the farm [शेत] premises.

Clinical Signs

Alert downers the animal is in sternal recumbency with normal feed [खाद्य/चारा] and water [पाणी] intake. Pulse [डाळ] and heart rates are initially normal but increase later. Creepers alert downer which makes repeated attempts to get up. Non-creeper alert downer cow [गाय], which makes no attempt to raise and prefers to remain in recumbency state. Non alert downer inappetence to anorexia, lateral recumbency.

Diagnosis [निदान]

History of recent parturition, dystocia, and prolonged recumbency. Elevated level of muscle specific enzymes, *viz.*, CPK (normal level - 40- 280 IU/litre) and AST. Decreased serum [सिरम] level of calcium [कॅल्शियम], phosphorus [स्फुरद] and magnesium. Mild to moderate proteinuria and ketonuria. Postmortem lesions include haemorrhage and degeneration in thigh muscles.

Differential Diagnosis [निदान]

Coliform mastitis [स्तनदाह] (presence of systemic signs and discolouration of milk [दूध] with enlarged udder [कास]) and fracture [हाड तुटणे] in limb (radiographic evidence of hip bone and or femur fracture [हाड तुटणे]).

MILK [दूध] FEVER [ताप]

Milk [दूध] fever [ताप], also known as hypocalcemia or parturient paresis, is a metabolic disorder that commonly affects dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cows during the early stages of lactation. It occurs due to a sudden drop in blood [रक्त] calcium [कॅल्शियम] levels, which can lead to muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता] or paralysis. Milk [दूध] fever [ताप] is primarily caused by an imbalance between the calcium [कॅल्शियम] demands of the cow [गाय] during early lactation and its ability to mobilize calcium [कॅल्शियम] from its body reserves or absorb calcium [कॅल्शियम] from its diet. Highproducing dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] cows experience a sudden increase in calcium [कॅल्शियम] requirements at the onset of lactation, as they need to produce and secrete large amounts of milk [दूध]. If the cow [गाय]'s dietary calcium [कॅल्शियम] intake is insufficient to meet these demands, it can lead to hypocalcemia. The treatment [उपचार] of milk [दूध] fever [ताप] involves raising the blood [रक्त] calcium [कॅल्शियम] levels in the affected cow [गाय]. This is typically achieved through the administration of intravenous calcium [कॅल्शियम] solutions, such as calcium [कॅल्शियम] gluconate or calcium [कॅल्शियम] borogluconate. Veterinary assistance is required to administer these treatments effectively. In severe cases, additional supportive therapy [सहायक उपचार], such as fluid therapy and antiinflammatory drugs, may be necessary.

Specific Nutritional Strategies could be as below -

1. Dietary management [व्यवस्थापन]: Balancing the prepartum diet to provide adequate, but not excessive, calcium [कॅल्शियम] and controlling the dietary cation-anion balance (DCAB) can help

prevent milk [दूध] fever [ताप]. A diet with an appropriate DCAB involves reducing potassium [पालाश] and sodium levels and increasing dietary calcium [कॅल्शियम] content.

- 2. Anionic salts supplementation: Feeding [खाऊ घालणे] anionic salts to cows in the weeks leading up to calving [व्याने] can help acidify their blood [रक्त], which aids in preventing milk [दूध] fever [ताप].
- 3. Monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख] body condition: Maintaining optimal body condition scores throughout the dry [कोरडे] period can reduce the risk of milk [दूध] fever [ताप].

Causes

Most cows naturally expel the placenta [झार] within six hours post-calving [व्याने], but when retention occurs beyond this timeframe, it can be classified as RFM. The condition is more prevalent in dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] herds.

Key risk factors [जोखमीचे घटक] include:

- Calving [व्याने] Difficulties: Cows that experience dystocia, premature birth, twin pregnancies, or abortion [गर्भपात] are at higher risk of RFM.
- Nutritional Deficiencies: Deficiencies in essential vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] and minerals [खनिजे] such as selenium, vitamin E, calcium [कॅल्शियम], magnesium, and zinc [झिंक] contribute to increased cases of retained placenta [झार बाहेर न पडणे].
- Metabolic Disorders: Conditions like milk [दूध] fever [ताप] and ketosis have been associated with RFM, especially in older cows with subclinical calcium deficiency [कॅल्शियमचा अभाव].
- Poor Calving [व्याने] Hygiene [स्वच्छता]: Unsanitary calving [व्याने] environments elevate the risk of bacterial infections, which can prolong placental retention and lead to secondary infections such as metritis [गर्भाशय संसर्ग].
- Induced Calving [व्याने]: Cows subjected to induced labor are more prone to RFM compared to those that calve naturally.

Prevention [प्रतिबंध] Strategies

Effective prevention [प्रतिबंध] of RFM requires a multifaceted approach focusing on proper nutrition [पोषण], herd [पशूंचे झुंड] management [व्यवस्थापन], and calving [व्याने] hygiene [स्वच्छता]. Key preventive measures include:

- Nutritional Management [व्यवस्थापन]: Ensure adequate intake of essential minerals [खनिजे], particularly selenium and vitamin E, to support immune function and uterine recovery. Balanced feeding [खाऊ घालणे] during the dry [कोरडे] period prevents cows from becoming overfat, reducing the risk of metabolic disorders.
- Calving [व्याने] Management [व्यवस्थापन]: Provide a clean and stress-free calving [व्याने] environment. Proper monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख] and timely assistance during difficult calvings can minimize complications [जटिलता].
- Milk [दूध] Fever [ताप] Control [नियंत्रण]: Older cows with a history of milk [दूध] fever [ताप] should receive calcium [कॅल्शियम] supplementation at calving [व्याने] to prevent hypocalcemia-related complications [जटिलता].
- Regular Health [आरोग्य] Monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख]: Maintain detailed records of calving [व्याने] outcomes and monitor cows post-calving [व्याने] for signs of infection [संसर्ग] or reproductive challenges.

results.answer:
जास्त वजनवाढ आणि वाढीच्या दृष्टीने शेळीच्या काही जाती विशेष ओळखल्या जातात:

- **डोळी शेळी:** नर ६० ते ९० कि.ग्रा., मादी ५० ते ६० कि.ग्रा. इतक्या मोठ्या आकाराच्या असल्यामुळे वजनवाढ चांगली येते.
- **जामुनाпари:** नर ५० कि.ग्रा., मादी २५ कि.ग्रा. इतके असून मांस उत्पादनासाठी चांगल्या मानल्या जातात.
- **सिंगणपरी:** प्रजननासाठी सुधारित शेळी वापरल्यास वजनवाढ १२ ते १५% ने वाढल्याचे नोंदवले आहे.
- **कोंकण काण्यल (कोकणासाठी):** पूर्ण वाढलेला नर साधारणपणे ५० कि.ग्रा. आणि मादी ३२ कि.ग्रा. पर्यंत जाणारी असून चांगली वाढ देणारी मानली आहे; तसेच १ वर्षाचे नर २५ कि.ग्रा. आणि मादी २१ कि.ग्रा. इतक्या असतात.

शेळीची जात निवडताना तूमच्या भागाचा हवामान, उपलब्ध खाऊ-चारा आणि विक्रीचा दृष्टीकोन पाहून निर्णय घेणे चांगले राहील.

**स्रोत: डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ, राहुरी**

2. Essential Performance traits:

However the control [नियंत्रण] of this trait by genetics is limited due to its low heritable nature. The litter [कचरा] size at birth varies from 2 to 16 in Indian condition depending upon breed [जाती]. Under average farming [शेती करणे] condition a moderately performing verity of pig [वराह] breed [जाती] gives eight to ten piglets per litter [कचरा]. The litter [कचरा] size at weaning should be seven to nine for optimum performance in Indian condition. Though breed [जाती] specific target for the trait can be fixed before selection.

b. Litter [कचरा] weight at birth and weaning: Weight is one of the main criteria for selection. Selection of healthy doe [मादी शेळी] and buck [शेळीचा नर] for breeding [प्रजनन]

Before purchasing, udder [कास] of female should be properly inspected for presence of any kind of defects. Females should only be mated after they have reached 70% of their adult body weight [शरीराचे वजन]. When does are bred too early, they produce more weaklings, which lead to a greater rate of kids loss. Both males and females should have an ideal body weight [शरीराचे वजन] corresponding to their age and breed [जाती]. Choosing males and females born as twins or triplets from a line of prolific parents leads to a significant improvement in the flock's kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे] percentage.

Vaccination [लसीकरण] of goats

All the goats should be vaccinated against major diseases of kids i.e. Enterotoxaemia, Tetanus [टेटॅनस] and Colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस]. Enterotoxaemia tends to be more deadly in young kids, and often in those which are the heaviest or fastest gaining and it is caused by the bacteria [जीवाणू] Clostridium perfringens types C and D. Tetanus [टेटॅनस] is a neurological disease [रोग] caused by a toxin which is produced by the bacterium Clostridium tetani. Clostridial organism is very common in soil [माती] and in the manure [खत] of animals. Bacterial spores enter the body through wounds caused by castration, ear tagging, disbudding [अनावश्यक कळ्या काढणे], kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे] etc, and symptoms [लक्षणे] occur 421 days later. Colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस] is one of the most common diseases of young kids with a high death rate. In neonatal coliform diarrhoea [अतिसार], enteropathogenic strains of Escherichia coli colonize the small intestine and produce an enterotoxin that causes diarrhoea [अतिसार]. Breeding [प्रजनन] females for enterotoxaemia and tetanus [टेटॅनस] should be vaccinated 46 weeks before kidding [शेळीच्या पिल्लांना जन्म देणे]. Pregnant goats for colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस] are vaccinated with two doses of vaccine subcutaneously 4050 and 1520 days before parturition against the natural form of enteric colibacillosis [कॉलिबॅसिलोसिस]. By vaccinating does in late pregnancy [गरोदरपणा], some immunity [रोगप्रतिकारशक्ती] may be passed on to the kids through the colostrum.

होय, कापसाचे धान्य तुडवून (काळी साखर) पोल्ट्री खाद्यात घेता येते, पण **सोयाबीन जेवण** ची पूर्णपणे जागा घेऊन त्याचे प्रमाण जास्त करता येत नाही. कारण कापूस धान्याच्या तुलनेत **फायबर** जास्त, पचणशीलता कमी, व पोषक घटक वेगवेगळे असतात. म्हणून कापसाचे धान्य फक्त **काही प्रमाणात** (आंशिक) वापरण्याची शिफारस आहे.

**आहार:**  
- संतुलित पोल्ट्री आहार हा पोषक घटकांची योग्य रक्कम व प्रमाण पुरवतो, म्हणून एक साहित्य जास्त घालता येत नाही — आंशिक बदल करा.
- कापूस धान्याचा वापर केला तर अंडी उत्पादन, वाढ किंवा आरोग्यावर परिणाम होऊ शकतो; म्हणून खातात कापसाचे धान्य जास्त न करता संतुलित राखणे महत्त्वाचे आहे.

**कापूस धान्य (आंशिक बदल):**  
- फायबर जास्त, पचणशीलता कमी, व वाण व प्रक्रिया पद्धतीनुसार पोषक घटकांमध्ये फरक असल्याने **पूर्ण बदल करणे शक्य नाही**.
- सोयाबीन जेवण सामान्यतः जास्त समान दर्जाचा असतो, त्यामुळे अत्यावश्यक बदलासाठीही कापूस धान्य **आंशिकच** मिसळण्याची शिफारस आहे.

**स्रोत: कुक्कुटपालन संशोधन संचालनालय, हैदराबाद — पोल्ट्री खाद्य क्षेत्रानुसार (पोल्ट्री फीड रिजन स्पेसिफिक)**

results.question: Paramparik nangaracha tulanet phirtya kulavache fayde konte ahet?
results.answer:
परंपरागत नांगर आणि फिरत्या कुलावा (रोटाव्हेटर/रोटोकल्टीव्हेटर) यांच्या तुलनेबद्दल या दस्तऐवजांमध्ये थेट तपशील मिळाला नाही.

तरीही, या दस्तऐवजांमध्ये जमिनीची मशागत, नांगरणी, वखरणी, आणि प्लास्टिक आच्छादनाखाली लागवड यामुळे खालील फायदे उल्लेखले आहेत:

- लागणीच्या वेळी जमिनीच्या वारंवार नांगरणी-वखरणीचे खर्च कमी होतात
- तणांचा प्रादुर्भाव कमी होतो आणि तण काढणीचे खर्च कमी होतात
- आच्छादनामुळे बाष्पीभवन कमी होते म्हणून पाणी बचत होते
- जमीनीची धूप कमी होते
- वेळेवर रोपण शक्य होते
- पीक चांगले वाढते, उत्पादन वाढते, आणि काही वेळा पिकण्याचा कालावधी कमी होतो

या दस्तऐवजांत फिरत्या कुलावा (रोटाव्हेटर/रोटोकल्टीव्हेटर) किंवा पट्टाशी नांगर यांच्या तुलनेत ठळक फायदे कोणते हे थेट सांगितलेले नाही; फक्त पट्टाशी नांगर आणि रोटाव्हेटर (रोटोपुडलरसह) यांची अनुदान/खर्च यादी आहे.

**स्रोत: कृषी व शेतकरी कल्याण विभाग (DAFW); डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (VNMAU)**

तुम्ही फिरत्या कुलावा म्हणजे रोटाव्हेटर, पट्टाशी नांगर, की वखर यंत्र हे वापरणार आहात, आणि तुमची जमीन मऊ, मध्यम की कठीण आहे?

At the same time, it is possible to use biodynamic, Jeevamrut [जीवामृत], Beejamrut [बीजामृत], Panchagavya [पंचगव्य] etc. in organic farming [सेंद्रिय शेती]. In addition to this, organic crop protection [सेंद्रिय पीक संरक्षण] recommendations have to be used to control [नियंत्रण] diseases and pests.

**Beejamrut [बीजामृत] (Seed Treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया]):** Beejamrut [बीजामृत] can be used for seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया]. To prepare Beejamrut [बीजामृत], mix 1 kg of native cow dung [शेण], 1 liter of cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], 100 ml of milk [दूध], 50 gm of lime [चुना], 50 gm of loamy soil [माती] and 100 gm of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] viride and soak this mixture overnight and can be used for seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] on the second day.

**Jeevamrut [जीवामृत]:** Mix 10 kg of cow [गाय] or bull dung [शेण], 10 liters of cow [गाय] urine [मूत्र], 2 kg of jaggery [गूळ], 2 kg of gram flour [हरभरा पीठ], 1 kg of forest soil [माती] in a plastic drum in 200 liters of water [पाणी] and stir the mixture 3 times a day for 5-7 days. This mixture can be given to the crop [पीक] in 1 acre area through water [पाणी].

**Amrut Pani:** Mix 10 kg of cow dung [शेण], 250 gm of cow [गाय] ghee [तूप] and 500 gm of jaggery [गूळ] in 200 liters of water [पाणी] and give this prepared Amrut Pani to 1 acre area through water [पाणी] at an interval of 30 days.
```

Biofertilizers [जैव खते]

A biofertilizer [जैविक खत] is a mixture of useful and efficient bacteria [जीवाणू] grown independently in a laboratory and mixed with a suitable carrier. Active and microscopic useful bacteria [जीवाणू] that can be used to make nitrogen [नत्र], phosphorus [स्फुरद], potash, and other micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] available to the crop [पीक] are called biofertilizers [जैव खते]. They are useful for accelerating the decomposition of organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] in the field [शेत].

Benefits of Biofertilizers [जैव खते]:

Biofertilizers [जैव खते] can enable efficient use of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते], saving on their usage. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] are environment-friendly. The germination [अंकुरण] power of seeds is increased and the crop [पीक] grows well due to the plant [रोप/वनस्पती] growth [वाढ] hormones released in the soil [माती] by biofertilizers [जैव खते]. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] are relatively cheap, which saves on production [उत्पादन] costs. Fungal diseases are also controlled to some extent due to the release of antibiotics in the soil [माती] by biofertilizers [जैव खते]. The texture of the soil [माती] improves by using biofertilizers [जैव खते]. Production [उत्पादन] increases by 15 to 20 per cent, and production [उत्पादन] costs decrease.

Types of Biofertilizers [जैव खते]: 1. Nitrogen [नत्र]-fixing bacteria [जीवाणू] - Rhizobium [रायझोबियम], Acetobacter, Azotobacter, Azospirillum, blue-green algae [निळा-हिरवा शैवाल], Azolla 2. Phosphorus [स्फुरद]-solubilizing bacteria [जीवाणू] 3. Potash-solubilizing bacteria [जीवाणू] 4. Bacteria [जीवाणू] that decompose organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] 5. Bacteria [जीवाणू] that make micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] available.

**Benefits of Biofertilizers [जैव खते] for Crops:**

1. Due to biofertilizers [जैव खते], the fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] of the soil [माती] increases, the texture improves, the soil [माती] becomes biologically active, and the production [उत्पादन] capacity increases.
2. Due to the large increase in the number and length of roots, water [पाणी] is available to the crop [पीक] from a distance and deep in the soil [माती] from the main stem.
3. As antitoxins are released in the soil [माती], the disease [रोग] and pest resistance [कीड प्रतिरोध / कीड प्रतिकारशक्ती] of the crops increases and the crop protection [पीक संरक्षण] costs are saved.
4. Useful nitrogen [नत्र] remains in reserve for the second sowing [पेरणी].
5. The quality of grains [धान्ये] improves, and the crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन] increases by approximately 15 to 30 percent.

**The following things should be kept in mind while using biofertilizers [जैव खते]:**

1. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] should not be kept in a hot place or in direct sunlight.
2. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] should not be mixed with insecticides [कीटकनाशके], fungicides [बुरशीनाशके], weedicides [तणनाशके], and chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते].
3. After applying biofertilizers [जैव खते] to the seeds, dry [कोरडे] them in the shade for half an hour.
4. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] should be used within the final date given.
5. They should be used only for the crops for which they are recommended.
6. It is necessary to have moisture in the soil [माती] to keep the biofertilizers [जैव खते] alive after applying them.

If the expected effect of biofertilizers [जैव खते] is not seen on the crop [पीक], there may be some of the following reasons:

1. Presence of already existing species [प्रजाती] of bacteria [जीवाणू] in the soil [माती].
2. Lack of other nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] in the soil [माती].
3. High stock of available nitrogen [नत्र] mineral in the soil [माती].
4. The biofertilizer [जैविक खत] used is of substandard quality.
5. Biofertilizer [जैविक खत] is used less than recommended.
6. Presence of poisonous substances in the seed coating [बियाणे कोटिंग].
7. Adulteration [भेसळ] of other bacteria [जीवाणू] in the biofertilizer [जैविक खत].
8. Bad condition of the soil [माती] (improper soil pH [मातीचा सामू / मृदा सामू] or high temperature [तापमान]).
9. Insufficient moisture in the soil [माती], insufficient carbon, and insufficient organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ].

Due to all the above reasons, the expected results of biofertilizers [जैव खते] are not seen.

1. Purchase saplings only from a reliable government approved nursery [रोपवाटिका]. Make sure that the mother tree orchard is free from oily spots/wilt disease [मररोग] and that the nursery [रोपवाटिका] has been inspected by experts.
2. Pomegranate [डाळिंब] should be planted only at a distance of 4.5 x 3.0 meters (15.0 x 10.0 feet) Avoid planting pomegranate [डाळिंब] at a shorter distance than this, because in such orchards, the rate of both oily spot disease [रोग] and wilt disease [मररोग] increases rapidly.
3. The first bahar should be retained approximately two years after planting the saplings, before that, retaining bahar makes the plants weak and susceptible to diseases early.
4. For higher economic benefit, in pomegranate [डाळिंब] planted at a distance of 4.5 x 3.0 m, it is appropriate that 20% area near the tree is under irrigation [सिंचन] by drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]. If more area than that is under irrigation [सिंचन], a microclimate [सूक्ष्म हवामान] is created in the orchard which increases the incidence of short hole borer [खोडकिडा] and wilt disease [मररोग].
5. In areas where stem borer [खोड किउा] infestation is high, it is appropriate to train pomegranate [डाळिंब] with four stems in light soil [हलकी माती].
6. To get quality fruit [फळ] production [उत्पादन] in pomegranate [डाळिंब], while doing bahar management [व्यवस्थापन], it is recommended to prune [आलूबुखारा] the outer branches at a distance of 20 cm from the tip after leaf [पान] fall and to thin out the inner branches so that plenty of sunlight reaches the central part.
7. Retain only one bahar in a year. After retaining bahar, keep the fruits controlled according to the size and age of the tree. This increases the size of the fruits and enables quality fruit [फळ] production [उत्पादन].
8. The use of micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] and biofertilizers [जैव खते] has been found to be beneficial for quality oriented production [उत्पादन].

10. Put fertilizers near the tree by making a furrow [सरी] or under the dripper and cover it with soil [माती].
11. If it is not possible to give water [पाणी] through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन], give water [पाणी] with the help of canal every 8 to 10 days in summer, 13 to 14 days in monsoon [पावसाळा] (when there is no rain) and 17 to 18 days in winter.

```
INTRODUCTION
Microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव], as an important driver of biogeochemical cycles, play a key role in soil fertility [मातीची सुपीकता / मृदा सुपीकता] and nutrient uptake [अन्नद्रव्य सेवन] by plants. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] include nitrogen fixing [नत्र स्थिरीकरण], phosphate, potassium [पालाश] and zinc [झिंक] solubilising; nutrient [पोषक घटक] mobilizing microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] used for application [वापर/फवारणी] to seed [बियाणे] or soil [माती]. The manipulation of rhizosphere [मुळमंडल किंवा मुळांचा परिसर / मूलक्षेत्र] of plants leads to increase in numbers of such microorganisms [सूक्ष्मजीव] and thereby accelerate the microbial processes which augment the availability of nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] that can be assimilated by plants. Biofertilizers [जैव खते] are economical and ecofriendly alternative of chemical fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]. Integrated nutrient management [समन्वित अन्नद्रव्य व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मीक पोषक व्यवस्थापन / एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन] (INM) considers biofertilizers [जैव खते] as an important component and advocates judicious application [वापर/फवारणी] of fertilizers along with organic [सेंद्रिय] manures and biofertilizers [जैव खते] which is imperative to sustain crop [पीक] production [उत्पादन] and maintenance of soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] in the long term.
Rhizosphere [मुळमंडल किंवा मुळांचा परिसर / मूलक्षेत्र] bacteria [जीवाणू] that favourably influence plant [रोप/वनस्पती] growth [वाढ] and yield [उत्पादन] of crop [पीक] plants are designated as plant [रोप/वनस्पती] growth [वाढ] promoting rhizobacteria [मुळाभोवतीचे जीवाणू] (PGPR). They not only influence plant [रोप/वनस्पती] growth [वाढ] but also help the plants to overcome abiotic and biotic stresses.
In India, biofertilizer [जैविक खत] industry has developed over years and many significant changes have taken place. The shift from carrier based to liquid formulations, inclusion of microbial consortium [सूक्ष्मजीव संघ / सूक्ष्मजिवांचा संघ] in Fertilizer [खत] Control [नियंत्रण] Order (FCO), increase in numbers of efficient strains have led to the surge in production [उत्पादन] of biofertilizers [जैव खते]. ICAR is continuously striving to develop quality assured biofertilizers [जैव खते] using efficient and competitive strains. This bulletin is a compilation of 41 biofertilizer [जैविक खत] technologies developed by ICAR that are at different stages of commercialization.

**Benefits of Earthworms for Agriculture [शेती]**

1. Earthworms improve soil texture [मातीचा पोत / जमीनीचा पोत].
2. Beneficial changes are brought about in the structure of soil [माती] particles.
3. Earthworm excreta is an excellent type of fertilizer [खत], called humus [ह्युमस]. From this, phosphorus [स्फुरद], potash, and other micronutrients [सुक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये] required for plant [रोप/वनस्पती] growth [वाढ] are easily and quickly available to the plants.
4. Natural tillage [जमिनीची मशागत] of the soil [माती] is done. This keeps the air circulating in the soil [माती] and promotes good root [मूळ] growth [वाढ].
5. The water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता] of the soil [माती] increases and water [पाणी] evaporation is very low.
6. Soil erosion [जमीनीची धुप] is reduced.
7. The pH of the soil [माती] is maintained at a proper level.
8. Earthworms bring the soil [माती] from the lower layers to the top and make it of good quality.
9. A huge increase in the number of beneficial bacteria [उपयुक्त जिवाणू] saves on fertilizer [खत] and water [पाणी] costs.
10. Strong growth [वाढ] of plants increases their ability to resist pests and diseases to some extent.
11. Vermicompost [गांडूळखत] is especially useful for food grains [धान्ये], vegetables, and fruit [फळ] gardens.

**Electric Motor**

Electric motors are of two types, AC and DC. Since Maharashtra has AC power supply in rural areas and fields, only AC motors are used. When power is supplied to a machine through one wire, it is called single-phase, and when it is supplied through three wires, it is called three-phase. For small tasks, motors with one horsepower (HP) or less power are supplied from one phase. But for high-power machines, power is supplied through three wires. When AC motors start, they try to draw about 3 to 5 times the electric current. Starters are used to avoid this.

**Things to consider when selecting a motor**

1. The motor and starter should be of a standard company (with ISI mark).
2. The price of the motor should be reasonable.
3. Take a motor of appropriate horsepower according to the nature of the work to be done.
4. Know how many revolutions per minute are required (taking into account the revolutions of the pump, mill, spinning wheel).
5. The place where the motor is to be installed should be protected from water [पाणी], dust, or garbage.

**Krushi VNMAU**
Source: वसंतराव नाईक मराठवाडा कृषी विद्यापीठ (VNMAU)
```
1. **Nitrogenous Bacterial Fertilizers Useful for Monocotyledonous and Cereal [तृणधान्य] Crops:** Azotobacter biofertilizer [जैविक खत] should be used for seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] of monocotyledonous and cereal [तृणधान्य] crops. Nitrogen fixation [नायट्रोजन स्थिरीकरण] takes place in Azotobacter cells, and the nitrogen [नत्र] fixed in the cells is later released from the cells through excretions. After the Azotobacter cells die, the fixed nitrogen [स्थिर नत्र] in them is taken up by the plant [रोप/वनस्पती] roots. Azotobacter bacteria [जीवाणू] fix the free nitrogen [नत्र] gas in the air and make it available to the crops. This results in vigorous growth [वाढ] of the crops and up to 10 to 25 percent higher production [उत्पादन]. This biofertilizer [जैविक खत] can be used for all crops except pulse [डाळ] crops, e.g., cereal [तृणधान्य], oilseed [तेलबिया], vegetable, fruit [फळ] trees, potato [बटाटा], sugarcane [ऊस], ginger [आले], flower trees, etc.
2. **Nitrogenous Bacterial Fertilizers Useful for Leguminous or Dicotyledonous Crops:** Rhizobium [रायझोबियम] biofertilizer [जैविक खत] should be used for seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] of leguminous or dicotyledonous crops. The function of Rhizobium [रायझोबियम] bacteria [जीवाणू] is carried out in a symbiotic manner with the crop [पीक]. These bacteria [जीवाणू] form nodules on the roots of pulse [डाळ] crops. By staying in these nodules, they absorb nitrogen [नत्र] gas from the air and make it available to the crop [पीक]. There are different species [प्रजाती] of Rhizobium [रायझोबियम] according to the crops. The species [प्रजाती] of one crop [पीक] are not useful for other crops. 4.1 Introduction

Soil [माती] is a fundamental resource for food production [उत्पादन] and a crucial asset for farmers. The success of farming [शेती करणे] relies on soil quality [मृदा गुणवत्ता], as it supplies water [पाणी] and vital nutrients [पोषक तत्वे] to crops. When soil [माती] is rich and healthy, combined with adequate water [पाणी] and sunlight, it supports productive farming [शेती करणे] and helps achieve desired yields. Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] treats soil [माती] as a living, multifunctional system [पद्धत/प्रणाली], where soil organic matter [मृदा सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], or humus [ह्युमस], serves as a critical reservoir supporting nutrient [पोषक घटक] retention, water-holding capacity [पाणी धरणक्षमता / पाणी धारण क्षमता], and soil structure [जमीनीची रचना / मृदा रचना] (FAO, 2015). Incorporating farmyard manure [शेणखत] or compost [कंपोस्ट] significantly enhances microbial activity [सूक्ष्मजैविक क्रिया] and diversity, thereby increasing soil [माती] resilience and nutrient cycling [अन्नद्रव्य चक्र / पोषण चक्र] through the activation of indigenous microbes (Semenov et al., 2021). Long-term use of organic [सेंद्रिय] amendments (e.g., FYM applied at 15 t/ha) markedly increases soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], dissolved organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन], and key nutrient [पोषक घटक] pools under pearl milletwheat rotations (Sheoran et al., 2025). Soil pH [मातीचा सामू / मृदा सामू], a key determinant of nutrient availability [पोषण मूल्य उपलब्धता], can be effectively managed using natural amendments: lime [चुना] in highly acidic soils-and manure [खत] or straw in moderately acidic soils-not only raise pH by 12-17%, but also improve cation exchange capacity [धनायन विनिमय / कॅटायन विनिमय क्षमता], organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ], and crop yield [पीक उत्पादन] (Zhang et al., 2023). A balanced soil [माती] ecosystem, therefore, emerges from the synergy of organic carbon [सेंद्रिय कार्बन] enrichment, microbial vitality, and pH correction, all achieved without synthetic inputs.

Indian Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] experiments have reported measurable improvements in soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] parameters. ICARNAARM field [शेत] studies under Zero Budget Natural Farming [शून्य खर्च नैसर्गिक शेती] in Andhra Pradesh recorded an increase of 821% in soil organic carbon [मृदामधील सेंद्रिय कार्बन / मातीतील सेंद्रिय कार्बन], 1327% higher microbial biomass [वनस्पती झाडे पीके व शैवाल यापासुन निर्माण होणारा सेंद्रीय पदार्थ] carbon, and significantly higher soil [माती] enzymatic activity compared to conventional farming [पारंपरिक शेती] systems. Similarly, long-term NF trials in soybeanmaize and wheatmustard systems reported 1.31.8 times higher populations of beneficial soil microbes [मृदा सूक्ष्मजीव] and improved soil aggregation [मातीचे एकत्रीकरण] and moisture retention [ओलावा टिकवून धरणे] under Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] practices.17

4.Potassium [पालाश]:

Potassium [पालाश] is the third most abundant mineral in the animal body and serves as the primary intracellular ion, with concentrations ranging from 100 to 160 mmol/L in body tissues. It plays a crucial role in maintaining nerve and muscle excitability, as well as regulating the body's water balance [जल संतुलन] and acid-base equilibrium. Potassium [पालाश] is also involved in cellular respiration [श्वसन] through the chloride shift and influences various intracellular processes, including enzyme function and muscle contraction.

For herbivores, potassium [पालाश] deficiency is uncommon, as most forages naturally contain adequate levels of this mineral. However, when deficiency does occur, it can lead to symptoms [लक्षणे] such as muscle weakness [अशक्तपणा / दुर्बलता], stiffness, paralysis, and intracellular acidosis. In potassium [पालाश]-deficient animals, the reduction of potassium [पालाश] in milk [दूध] is more pronounced than in plasma [प्लाझ्मा]. Dairy [दुग्धव्यवसाय] calves with marginal potassium [पालाश] deficiency may show decreased appetite [भूक] and reduced weight gain [वजन वाढ], even when plasma [प्लाझ्मा] potassium [पालाश] levels appear normal.

The identification of methionine, an essential amino acid containing one sulphur [गंधक] atom per molecule, highlighted the importance of sulphur [गंधक] as a dietary nutrient [पोषक घटक]. Sulphur [गंधक] is found in connective tissues as sulphate and is a component of the natural anticoagulant [रक्त गोठणे प्रतिबंधक द्रव्य] heparin [हेपारिन]. It is also present in important hormones such as insulin and oxytocin, as well as in vitamins [जीवनसत्त्वे] like thiamine and biotin. Sulphur [गंधक] is abundant in keratin-rich structures including hooves [खुर], horns, feathers, wool fibre, and mohair. The rumen [रुमेन]'s microbial flora can incorporate inorganic sulphur [गंधक] into microbial proteins, which then serve as a high-quality amino acid source for the animal.

Symptoms [लक्षणे] of sulphur deficiency [गंधकाची कमतरता / गंधक कमतरता] include slowed growth [वाढ], excessive shedding of wool or hair, profuse salivation, excessive tearing, and in severe cases, emaciation leading to death.

Diagnosis [निदान]

Diagnosis [निदान] often reveals low blood [रक्त] pH, *P*CO2 and bicarbonate levels, along with elevated D-lactate and blood [रक्त] urea [यूरिया] nitrogen [नत्र] (BUN).

Treatment [उपचार]

Depending on the extent of the disease [रोग] condition, intravenous isotonic 1.3-1.4 % solution of sodium bicarbonate solution is given as treatment [उपचार].

Alkalosis

Elevated blood [रक्त] pH is the hallmark of alkalemia, also known as metabolic alkalosis, which is often driven on by excessive acid loss, increased absorption of alkali, or a carbon dioxide deficiency.

Etiology [रोगकारण]

Metabolic alkalosis commonly arises from condition like abomasal atony, which may occur due to abomasal impaction. Under these events, potassium [पालाश] and hydrochloric acid are continuously secreted into the abomasum, resulting in hyperchloremic and hypokalaemia alkalosis. Furthermore, metabolic alkalosis can cause a shift in potassium [पालाश] from extracellular to intracellular locations, which may exacerbate hypokalaemia even in cases where the body potassium [पालाश] levels are acceptable.

Clinical signs

Animal alkalosis may be challenging to diagnose due to a lack of specific clinical symptoms [लक्षणे]. It frequently causes convulsions, tetany, tremors in the muscles, and shallow respirations. In more severe phases, dyspnoea and hyperpnea can appear.

Treatment [उपचार]

Treating alkalosis in animals involves fluid therapy with 0.9% isotonic saline along with electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] management [व्यवस्थापन], including giving potassium [पालाश] chloride (KCl) at 20-40 mEq/L IV, are crucial.

Definition and causes

Net losses from gastrointestinal diseases account for most animal electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] abnormalities. The etiologies of electrolyte [विद्युतद्रव] imbalance include vomiting, burn exudation, sweating, and excessive salivation. तुमच्या प्रश्नात "निंबोळी पेंडी" म्हणजे निंबोळीचा पेंड (नीम केक) की निंबोळी अर्क हे थोडे अस्पष्ट दिसते, कारण दस्तऐवजांमध्ये दोन्हीची वापराची वेगळी माहिती आहे.

**निंबोळीचा पेंड (नीम केक) — जमिनीसाठी वापर:**  
**मृदा आरोग्य:** जैविक बुरशीनाशक (उदा. ट्रायकोडर्मा) वापरायचं असेल तर ते सेंद्रिय खते, पेंड आणि शेणखत यांच्याबरोबर मिसळून शेतात १५ ते २० दिवस पेरणी/लागवडीपूर्वी, माती ओल्या अवस्थेत टाकले तरी चांगला परिणाम मिळतो; या पद्धतीने शेतातील प्रत्येक ग्रॅम मातीमध्ये जैविक बुरशींचे प्रमाण वाढते.  
**मात्रा/वेळ:** विडा पान/बेलवेलीसाठी नीम केक २० क्विंटल प्रति हेक्टर मातीमध्ये दोन वेळेत (जून आणि डिसेंबर) द्या, किंवा ट्रायकोडर्मा १० कि.ग्रा. २० क्विंटल प्रति हेक्टर नीम केकमध्ये मिसळून जून आणि डिसेंबरमध्ये दोन वेळी द्या.  
**इतर वापर:** काही वेळा उर्व्हियाचा वापर नीम केकमध्ये ५:१ या प्रमाणे करायचा असल्याची सूचना आहे.

**निंबोळी अर्क (नीम एक्सट्रॅक्ट) — पानांवर फवारणी:**  
**फवारणी:** नीम दाण्यांचा अर्क ५% तयार करून (५ कि.ग्रा. नीम दाणे ९ लि. पाण्यात रात्री भिजवून सकाळी चाळून साबण द्रावण मिसळून एकूण १० लि. मिळवून, १ लि. अर्क ९ लि. पाण्यात मिसळून) त्याच दिवशी फवारणीसाठी वापरा.  
**विषय:** जमिनीत नीम अर्क टाकण्याची पद्धत/मात्रा या दस्तऐवजांमध्ये सापडली नाही; नीम अर्काची फवारणी म्हणून माहितीच आहे.

तुम्हाला पेंड म्हणजेच नीम केक वापरायचा आहे की नीम अर्क (द्रव) फवारणी/वापरायचा आहे, आणि हे कोणत्या पिकासाठी किंवा कोणत्या कामासाठी (जमिनीत मिसळणे, लागवडीपूर्व, लागवडीनंतर) हवे आहे?

**स्रोत: डॉ. बाळासाहेब सावंत कोकण कृषी विद्यापीठ, दापोली २०२५; डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख कृषी विद्यापीठ, अकोला; महात्मा फुले कृषी विद्यापीठ (एम.पी.के.व्ही.), राहुरी**

पेंड वापर जमिनीत टाकण्यासाठी आहे की अर्क पिकांवर फवारणीसाठी आहे, आणि कोणत्या पिकासाठी हवे?

Yield [उत्पादन]: 25 to 30 tons per hectare  
Storage [साठवण]: Fruits can be stored in good condition for 4-6 months.

## **Neem [कडूलिंब]**

1. Soil [माती]

The scientific name of this tree is Azadirachta indica. The Neem [कडूलिंब] tree grows in hilly slopes, rocky, barren, light [प्रकाश], medium heavy soil [माती]. Waterlogged soils that do not drain are unsuitable for Neem [कडूलिंब] cultivation. In many places, the Neem [कडूलिंब] tree asserts its existence in adverse conditions where other trees cannot survive.

1. Climate [हवामान]

Very high temperatures, severe cold, and fog are not tolerated by the tree. An area with 450 to 1125 mm of rainfall is considered suitable for the good growth [वाढ] of Neem [कडूलिंब]. Satisfactory growth [वाढ] is also found in areas with a minimum of 250 mm of rainfall. The rate of growth [वाढ] is higher in hot and dry [कोरडे] climates.

1. Seed [बियाणे] Collection and Planting Method

The seed germination [बियाणे अंकुरण] period is only 50 days from the time the seed [बियाणे] is collected from the tree. For large-scale cultivation in remote areas, sowing [पेरणी] seeds before the rainy season [हंगाम/ऋतू] is more profitable and cost-effective. For this, collect the ripe fresh fruits. They should be from straight and vigorously growing trees. Separate the seeds from the pulp in the fruit [फळ], wash them with clean water [स्वच्छ पाणी], and sow [मादी डुक्कर] them immediately to get more germination [अंकुरण] capacity.
