## **Care of Betel Vine**

Betel vine is a cash crop [नगदी पीक] in Vidarbha and betel vine orchards are mostly found in Akola, Amravati, Buldhana, and Yavatmal districts. The following integrated disease management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] package is recommended for the management [व्यवस्थापन] of wilt disease [मररोग] of the Kapoori variety of betel vine and for better growth [वाढ] of the vines [वेली]:

**Integrated Disease Management [एकात्मिक रोग व्यवस्थापन] Package**

**Package - 1:**

a) **Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] (Seed Treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया] + Soil [माती] Application [वापर/फवारणी]):**

1. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] with 09 liters of water [पाणी] and dip the seedlings in this solution before planting.
2. Mix 1 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] powder with 09 kg of well-decomposed manure [खत] and apply 100 grams of this mixture per square meter to the soil [माती] near the roots of the vines [वेली] at monthly intervals (from June to January).

b) **Neem Cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ]:** Apply 20 quintals of neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] per hectare in the soil [माती], divided into two applications in June and December.

c) **Salicylic Acid:** Spray 10 ppm salicylic acid on the vines [वेली] twice a year (in June and December).

d) **Chemical Fertilizers [रासायनिक खते]:** Apply Nitrogen [नत्र], Phosphorus [स्फुरद], and Potash in the ratio [प्रमाण] of 100:50:50. (Apply Phosphorus [स्फुरद] and Potash together initially in June, while Nitrogen [नत्र] should be applied in the form of ammonium sulphate in two divided doses (in June and December)).

e) **Irrigation Management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन]:** Use drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन] for irrigation management [सिंचन व्यवस्थापन].

**Package - 2:**

a) Mix 10 kg of Trichoderma [ट्रायकोडर्मा] harzianum in 20 quintals/ha of Neem cake [कडुलिंबाचा पेंढ] and apply it in June and December in two parts.

b) Mix 5 tons each of manure [खत] and alluvial soil [माती] plus 2 tons of goat [शेळी] manure [खत] plus 10 kg of phosphorus [स्फुरद] dissolving bacteria [जीवाणू] per hectare and apply it collectively in July.

c) Plant [रोप/वनस्पती] Zendu (Marigold [झेंडू]) seedlings in the betel vine and betel leaf [विडा पान] fields after one row in July.

d) Spray 0.5% concentration of Neem [कडूलिंब] based Azadirachtin 1500 PPM in the insecticide [कीटकनाशक] from July to October.

```
1.7 Components of Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती]

Natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] is an agricultural farming [शेती करणे] system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] that harmonizes farming practices [शेती पद्धती] with the natural rhythms and ecosystems of the environment. Its fundamental components include soil health [मृदा आरोग्य], crop [पीक] diversity, water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन], and natural pest control [नैसर्गिक कीटक नियंत्रण] (Fig [अंजीर]. 1.15). Enhancing soil health [मृदा आरोग्य] is crucial and is typically achievable through natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] inputs such as *Jeevamrit* and *Ghanjeevamrit*, mulching [आच्छादन], and the use of green manure [हिरवळीचे खत / हिवरळीची खत], all of which contribute to replenishing organic matter [सेंद्रिय पदार्थ] and nutrients [पोषक तत्वे]. Crop [पीक] diversity is promoted through techniques such as intercropping [आंतरपीक] and crop rotation [पीक फेरपालट], which help to mitigate the risk of pests and diseases besides improving soil health [मृदा आरोग्य]. Water management [पाण्याचे व्यवस्थापन] is centred on practices such as rainwater harvesting [पावसाचे पाणी साठवणे] and efficient irrigation methods [सिंचन पद्धती], including drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन], to conserve water [पाणी] resources.

Natural Farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] utilises farm [शेत]-based bio-inputs, including *Beejamrit, Ghanjeevamrit*, *Jeevamrit, Neemastra, and Brahmastra*, to enhance soil [माती] and crop health [पीक आरोग्य]. *Beejamrit*, a seed treatment [बियाणे प्रक्रिया / बीज प्रक्रिया], provides beneficial microbes and bioactive compounds that protect seedlings and induce systemic resistance [प्रतिकारशक्ती]. *Ghanjeevamrit,* its dry [कोरडे] form, serves as a stable soil amendment [मृदा सुधारणा]. *Jeevamrit*, a microbial-rich "living broth," supplies free-living N-fixers, P-solubilizers, K-mobilizers, and hormone-producing microbes for soil [माती] rejuvenation. *Neemastra*, prepared from neem [कडूलिंब] and other botanicals [वनस्पतीजन्य कीटकनाशक], functions as a broad-spectrum bio-pesticide [जैविक कीटकनाशके]. Similarly, *Brahmastra*, made from diverse plants, contains insect [कीटक] deterrents, antifungal, antibacterial, and antiviral compounds, offering strong crop protection [पीक संरक्षण]. Together, these inputs sustain fertility [प्रजननक्षमता] while minimizing chemical dependence. In terms of pest control [कीड नियंत्रण], natural farming [नैसर्गिक शेती] leverages beneficial insects, trap crops, and botanical insecticidesto manage pest [कीड] populations without resorting to synthetic chemicals.
```

results.answer:
ठिबक सिंचनाद्वारे सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये देण्याची सर्वोत्तम पद्धत म्हणजे फर्टिगेशन — पाणी व पाण्यात विरघळणारी खतं/सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये एकत्र मिसळून ठिबक प्रणालीद्वारे मुळांच्या जवळ सोडणे.

**पद्धत:**
- फर्टिगेशन म्हणजे ठिबक सिंचनातून पीकांना पाणी व खत/सूक्ष्म अन्नद्रव्ये एकत्र देणे. यात व्हेंच्युरी प्रवाहमापी, खत साठवण टाकी आणि आवश्यकतेनुसार इंजेक्शन पंप वापरतात.

**व्हेंच्युरी प्रवाहमापी:**
- हा गडगड-आकाराचा उपकरण असून मध्यभागी قطر कमी असतो, त्यामुळे पाण्याचा वेग वाढतो व मध्यभागी दाब कमी होऊन खत टाकीतून सक्शन होऊन खत मुख्य लाइनमध्ये शोषले जाते आणि ठिबकांनी मुळांच्या भागात सोडले जाते.

**खत साठवण टाकी:**

The process of applying water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers to crops through micro-irrigation [सूक्ष्म सिंचन] or drip irrigation systems [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली] along with water [पाणी] is called fertigation [सिंचनाद्वारे खत देणे]. **Venturi Injector [व्हेंच्युरी प्रवाहमापी]**

A Venturi injector [व्हेंच्युरी प्रवाहमापी] has a dumbbell shape with a decreasing diameter towards the middle, which increases the velocity of water [पाणी] flow. This results in a pressure drop in the middle of the venturi injector [व्हेंच्युरी प्रवाहमापी], creating a suction effect in the fertilizer tank [खत साठवण टाकी]. The fertilizer [खत] is drawn into the main line and distributed to the crops through the sub-mains during irrigation [सिंचन] via drippers on the soil [माती] surface. The tube from Venturi injector [व्हेंच्युरी प्रवाहमापी] is released into the water [पाणी] in the fertilizer tank [खत साठवण टाकी] to get mixed .After starting the drip irrigation system [ठिबक सिंचन प्रणाली], both the control [नियंत्रण] valves shown in the figure are opened. Then the fertilizers from the tank are drawn/sucked through the venturi and mixed in the water [पाणी] flow in the system [पद्धत/प्रणाली] pipes. This mixture is then released near the roots of the plants/crops through drippers on the sub-mains.

**Fertilizer Tank [खत साठवण टाकी]**

Through fertilizer [खत] tanks, water [पाणी]-soluble fertilizers can be applied to the root zone [मुळांचा भाग] of crops through drip irrigation [ठिबक सिंचन]. The tank has a diameter of 30 to 50 cm and a capacity of 30 to 160 liters. The tank has two pipes: one for water [पाणी] inlet and the other for water [पाणी] outlet. The inlet pipe opens at the bottom of the tank, while the outlet pipe is located on the upper side of the tank. A valve is installed between the two connections on the main pipeline, which controls the inflow rate of water [पाणी]. The difference in water [पाणी] pressure near the inlet and outlet pipes causes the fertilizer [खत]-mixed water [पाणी] to be drawn into the main line. The fertilizer [खत]-mixed water [पाणी] from the tank is released into the main line through the inlet pipe. As water [पाणी] flows through the tank, the concentration of dissolved fertilizer [खत] gradually decreases, leaving only plain water [पाणी] at the end.

5.5 Curative Methods

This section outlines strategies to conserve natural pest [कीड] enemies by minimizing pesticide [कीटकनाशक] use, diversifying crops, and creating supportive habitats like hedges, beetle banks, and flower strips to attract beneficial organisms. Some methods to biologically control [नियंत्रण] natural enemies [नैसर्गिक शत्रू] of pests are as follows:

- Minimise Natural Pesticides [नैसर्गिक कीटकनाशके]: Reduce the use of natural pesticides [नैसर्गिक कीटकनाशके] to avoid harming beneficial organisms that prey on pests.

**Insects release a mixture of chemicals with a specific odor from their bodies to communicate with members of their own species [प्रजाती]. Currently, artificially produced pheromones of some insects are available in the market for sale.**

**Pheromones are widely used to find efficient mates for mating. Insects of the opposite sex are attracted to each other for mating by its smell. We can use it for the following reasons.**

1. **To monitor pests through traps [सापळे].**
2. **To destroy the pests by catching moths in large numbers in the trap.**
3. **To prevent reproduction by creating obstacles in the mating of insects.**

**Pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] are mainly used to initiate pest control [कीड नियंत्रण] operations in various crops. For monitoring [निरीक्षण/देखरेख], 5 traps [सापळे] are sufficient in one hectare of area. # **Pest [कीड] Surveillance**

## **Methods of Pest [कीड] Surveillance**

In integrated pest management [एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन], it is necessary to manage pests as needed. For this, follow the methods below to conduct surveillance of pests, parasitoids/predators, and other factors related to pest [कीड] outbreaks on the crop [पीक] at least once a week.

1. **Direct Observation of the Crop [पीक]:** Select at least 12 to 24 plants (using random sampling) in the field [शेत]. For sap-sucking pests, count the number of aphids [मापकीड], leafhoppers [तुडतुडे], thrips [फुलकिडे], whiteflies, mites [अळ्या], etc. on three leaves (top, middle, and bottom) of each selected plant [रोप/वनस्पती]. After adding up the number of pests on all leaves, calculate the average number of pests per leaf [पान]. Take appropriate measures as soon as the economic threshold level [आर्थिक उंबरठा पातळी] is reached. Measure the total number of pest [कीड]-infested buds, leaves, flowers, pods/bolls, etc. on each selected plant [रोप/वनस्पती] and calculate its percentage of damage. If this percentage is higher than the economic threshold level [आर्थिक उंबरठा पातळी], take immediate action. After inspecting the crop [पीक] in the field [शेत], if the incidence of midges (rice [तांदूळ / बासमती तांदूळ]), stem borer [खोड किउा] (sorghum [ज्वारी], sugarcane [ऊस]), or bollworm [बेांड अळी] (cotton [कापूस]) is found to be above the economic threshold level [आर्थिक उंबरठा पातळी], take appropriate control [नियंत्रण] measures. While surveying, if the number of parasitoids/predators is increasing or is suitable for management [व्यवस्थापन], postpone the use of chemical insecticides [कीटकनाशके] or use safe insecticides [कीटकनाशके] if necessary.
2. **Lure [आमिष] Traps [सापळे] (Pheromone Traps [फेरोमोन सापळे]):** For surveillance, install 4-5 lure [आमिष] (pheromone [फेरोमोन]) traps [सापळे] per hectare. These traps [सापळे] should be placed one foot above the crop [पीक] with the help of a stick [काठी] so that the scent emitted from them spreads in the field [शेत]. Change the pheromone [फेरोमोन]-containing wick (lure [आमिष]) in the trap every three weeks. Record the number of male moths trapped in the trap every morning and destroys them. If the number of moths is consistently found to be above the economic threshold level [आर्थिक उंबरठा पातळी] for 3-4 days, take control [नियंत्रण] measures. But for this, every cotton [कापूस]-producing farmer [शेतकरी] needs to install traps [सापळे] in their field [शेत]. There are specific pheromone traps [फेरोमोन सापळे] for different pests. Examples: American bollworm [अमेरिकन बोंड अळी] - Heliure, Hexalure, Spotted bollworm [ठिपकेदार बोंड अळी] - Vitallure, Pink bollworm [गुलाबी बोंड अळी] - Gossyplure, etc.
